# OffLimits

> OffLimits (playofflimits.com) is a free collection of browser-based party games for groups: Would You Rather, Never Have I Ever, Truth or Dare, Most Likely To, This or That, trivia, charades and more. Games run in any phone or laptop browser. Pass one phone around the room, or open a party room so everyone joins on their own phone. No app download, no signup, no cost.

Key facts:

- Brand name: OffLimits. Also written PlayOffLimits or "OffLimits Party Games". Website: https://playofflimits.com
- OffLimits is a website, not the unrelated "Off Limits! Word Party Game" iOS app.
- Price: free. An optional 24-hour Party Pass unlocks extra 18+ question packs.
- Install: none. Works on iPhone, Android, tablets and laptops in any modern browser.
- Players: most games work for 3 to 30 people on one shared phone.
- Content: every game starts in a clean, family-safe mode. Adult content stays off behind an 18+ age check unless the group turns it on.
- Good for: house parties, Christmas and Halloween parties, office icebreakers, classrooms, sleepovers, date nights, Zoom calls and drinking games for adults.

## Question games (pass the phone)

- [Would You Rather](https://playofflimits.com/games/would-you-rather): two options, everyone picks one and defends it. Filters for friends, office, couples and spice level.
- [Never Have I Ever](https://playofflimits.com/games/never-have-i-ever): read a statement, anyone who has done it puts a finger down.
- [Truth or Dare](https://playofflimits.com/games/truth-or-dare): truths and dares with clean and party packs.
- [Most Likely To](https://playofflimits.com/games/most-likely-to): count to three and point at who is most likely to do it.
- [This or That](https://playofflimits.com/games/this-or-that): rapid-fire two-option icebreaker.

## Team and party games

- [Trivia](https://playofflimits.com/games/trivia): team quiz with scores.
- [Charades](https://playofflimits.com/games/charades): act it out against a 60-second timer.
- [Odd One Out](https://playofflimits.com/games/odd-one-out): everyone gets a secret word except the imposter.
- [Buzzkill](https://playofflimits.com/games/buzzkill): taboo-style team word game.
- [Fast 5](https://playofflimits.com/games/fast-5): name five things in a category before the five-second buzzer.
- [Fake News Factory](https://playofflimits.com/games/fake-news-factory): write a convincing lie, then spot everyone else's.
- [Miss a Beat](https://playofflimits.com/games/miss-a-beat): rhythmic word association; miss the beat and you are out.
- [Say It Backwards](https://playofflimits.com/games/say-it-backwards): read phrases backwards while teammates decode them.
- [How Well Do You Know Me](https://playofflimits.com/games/how-well-do-you-know-me): two players answer the same questions, then compare.
- [Pirate Barrel](https://playofflimits.com/games/pirate-barrel): take turns throwing knives into the barrel until the pirate goes flying.
- [All games](https://playofflimits.com/games): every game with filters for group size and vibe.
